# Modifications to O*NET® content: DreamCo Occupation Synthesis Pack (built with O*NET® 31.0 data), version 0.0.2

Internal SKU id: `DP-ONET-OCC-SYN` (internal identifier only; a buyer-facing id will be decided before any listing).

The O*NET® Database license asks users who modify O*NET® information to indicate the changes, and recommends a file listing them
(https://www.onetcenter.org/license_db.html; CC BY 4.0 s.3(a)(1)(B)). This is that file. Generator:
`tools/build_dp_onet_occ_syn_sample.py` (build_dp_onet_occ_syn_sample 0.1.1). Input: `db_31_0_csv.zip`, sha256
`55033fc68b4c13ec23e7f74dc6378660f6e854e75d55d6e333ae0a761d3987cd`, verified against `provenance_manifest.json` before parsing.

## What DreamCo changed

1. **Selection.** 44 of the 1,016 O*NET-SOC occupations: 2 per SOC major group (22 groups; group 55, military, has no
   ratings). Eligible occupations have a Job Zone, Knowledge, Essential Skills and Work Activities ratings and at least
   one Core task. Within a group, the two with the smallest sha256("dp-onet-occ-syn-0.0.2:<code>") are taken.
2. **Subsetting.** Only the O*NET-SOC code, title, Job Zone, and the top 5 Knowledge, Essential Skills and Work Activities
   elements by Importance (scale IM) are kept, with their IM values rounded to 2 decimals. Level (LV) ratings, standard
   errors, confidence bounds and all other files are dropped. Occupation descriptions and task statement text are not
   included; tasks are reduced to counts by Task Type (Core, Supplemental, unclassified).
3. **Filtering.** Ratings with Recommend Suppress = "Y" are excluded from the rankings (counted in
   `data_confidence.suppressed_ratings_excluded`).
4. **Re-ordering.** Elements are ranked by IM, descending (ties by Element ID). The O*NET® Database does not publish these rankings.
5. **Derived values (DreamCo method).** `capability_lenses` (mean IM of DreamCo-grouped 4.A.* activities, rescaled to
   0-1), `lens_lift` (lens score minus the all-occupation mean), `dominant_lens`, `knowledge_lens`, `preparation_band`
   (DreamCo label for the Job Zone; 31.0 combines zones 1 and 2 as "Job Zone 1-2", stored as 2) and `data_confidence`
   (rating dates, N, rating sources, suppressed count).
6. **DreamCo text.** Practice seeds, rubric dimensions and agree / caveat / improve / still-need-test analysis are
   template-generated by DreamCo. They embed O*NET® titles and element names.
7. **Format.** Values are re-encoded as JSON Lines plus a Markdown card per occupation.

## What DreamCo did not change

O*NET-SOC codes, titles, element IDs, element names and the IM values that are kept are as published (values rounded to
2 decimals, which is the precision of the published O*NET® data). Every O*NET®-derived field is traceable through the row's
`source_refs` (file, member sha256, keys).

USDOL/ETA has not approved, endorsed, or tested these modifications.
